welcomeSub: Where the Gita was spoken. Plan a route around the time you actually have.
howExplore: How would you like to begin?
planVisitD: A route built around your time and interests
browseD: Every tirtha, temple and museum on the list
highlightsD: What to see if this is your first visit
nearMeD: What is worth reaching from where you are
greeting: How long do you have in {city}?
greetingSub: Pick a window and we will build a route that fits inside it.
q_time_s: Everything we suggest will fit inside this window.
q_start_s: This becomes the first point on the route.
q_end_s: The return leg is counted in the time.
q_how_s: Only what we need for honest timings.
doneD: That is the whole route. We hope it went well.
recalcD: We rebuilt the rest from where you are now.
trimmed: We dropped a stop to keep you on time.
nothingD: Try a different word, or clear the filters.
savedNoneD: Save a place or a route and it will wait here.
aboutD: A tour companion for the 48 Kos Kurukshetra tirtha land, built on the Kurukshetra Development Board's Tirtha Vivarnika.
estimates: Travel times are estimates based on distance. Live traffic is not used.
srcText: Descriptions come from the Kurukshetra Development Board's Tirtha Vivarnika and notes supplied for this project. Coordinates and opening hours come from Google Maps Platform. Suggested durations and best times are drawn from those hours and from visitor reports, and are guidance rather than fact.
photoText: Images are from Wikimedia Commons under Creative Commons licences. Author and licence are listed against each. Replace them with the Board's own photography before public release.
permD: We use it to estimate travel time and show what is near you. It is not stored.
pickTheme: Choose at least one interest above
noFitD: Try a longer window, fewer themes, or a brisker pace.
noRouteD: Tell us how long you have and we will build one.
mapNote: Positions are to scale. Directions open in Google Maps.
dlSub: Keep it on your home screen. Once installed it works without a signal.
dlIosIntro: On iPhone and iPad this is done from Safari's Share menu. It takes three taps.
dlAndIntro: Your browser can add this app to your home screen from its own menu.
dlIos2d: Scroll the list down if you do not see it straight away.
dlIos3d: The app lands on your home screen with the Board's seal.
dlAnd1d: The three dots at the top right in Chrome.
dlAnd2d: It may instead read Add to Home screen.
pinPendingD: We have the Board's description of this place but not a verified map location yet, so directions and route planning are switched off for it.
accountWhy: An account keeps your saved plans when you change phone. You can use the whole app without one.
haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
notifyTitle: Be told when something is on
notifyBody: A procession starting, a temple closed for the day, an aarti time changed. Only things happening in Kurukshetra — a few times a month.
notifyBlocked: Notifications are blocked in your browser settings.
tooManyTries: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
forgotWhy: Type the address you signed up with. If there is an account, we will send a link to choose a new password.
resetSent: If that address has an account, a link is on its way. Check your email.
chooseNewWhy: Pick a password of at least 8 characters. You will sign in with it on the next screen.
checkYourEmail: Almost done — open the email we just sent and tap the link to confirm your address. Then sign in here.
emailConfirmed: Email confirmed. You can sign in now.
confirmEmailWhy: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. Type it below. It expires in ten minutes.
signInHint: If you have not made an account yet, tap “Create an account” below.
cityPickD: The 48 Kos tirtha land spans several towns. Lists, routes and weather follow the one you pick.
exHint: Tap the plus on any card to add it to your day.
itHas: Your day already has {n} — tap to see it.
